name: North Node Semantics
description: Defines development, practice, capacity building, range expansion, experimentation, and integration.

coreDomains.name: Development
coreDomains.definition: The gradual strengthening of a less familiar but complementary capacity.
boundaries: Development does not erase existing capacity.

coreDomains.name: Practice
coreDomains.definition: Repeated engagement with a less familiar function under feedback.

coreDomains.name: Capacity Building
coreDomains.definition: Increasing usable competence in an emerging function.

coreDomains.name: Range Expansion
coreDomains.definition: Adding complementary responses to the available operating repertoire.

coreDomains.name: Developmental Experimentation
coreDomains.definition: Testing less familiar responses without assuming they are already integrated.
boundaries: Experimentation is not commitment to outcome.
May reveal that some forms are not useful.

coreDomains.name: Integration
coreDomains.definition: Coordinating emerging capacity with established South Node resources.
boundaries: Integration does not mean equal use at all times.

domainRelationships.relationship: New capacity broadens the available response range.
Expanded range becomes useful when coordinated with established strengths.
Experimentation identifies which responses deserve continued practice.

semanticExclusions: Do not derive destiny from development.
Do not derive virtue from unfamiliarity.
Do not derive failure from difficulty.
Do not derive abandonment of the South Node from range expansion.
Do not derive guaranteed fulfillment from practice.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Directional developmental vocabulary only. No destiny, fate, moral ranking, or guaranteed outcome claims are permitted.
